name: Cisco ASA — Internal Web Server Initiating Outbound Connection
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter _raw_log contains "302013" or _raw_log contains "302014"
| alter int_host = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_ip,
        int_iface = _json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_interface,
        ext_dest  = _json -> generalCiscoLog.src_ip,
        int_port  = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.dst_port),
        ext_port  = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.src_port),
        proto     = _json -> generalCiscoLog.protocol,
        bytes_n   = to_integer(_json -> generalCiscoLog.transferred_bytes)
| filter int_iface = "inside" and int_host in ("10.0.10.50","10.0.10.51","10.0.10.52","192.168.110.243")
| comp sum(bytes_n) as c2_bytes,
       values(ext_port) as ext_ports,
       values(int_port) as int_ports,
       values(proto) as protocols
       by int_host, ext_dest
| filter c2_bytes >= 10000
| fields ext_ports, int_ports, protocols, int_host, ext_dest
description: Cisco ASA Built/Teardown event where the internal host (xdm.target.ipv4) is a known web/app server IP making outbound — reversal of normal traffic direction indicates compromise.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — Internal Web Server Initiating Outbound Connection
